name: 1958 Impala Sedan Door Edge Guards
description: Original-style door edge guards for the 1958 Chevrolet Impala sedan. Door edge guards sit on the leading edge of each door and protect the paint from chips and scrapes when doors are opened near walls, posts or other cars. This is a full set of 6, enough to complete a sedan, in NOS / excellent condition. A correct finishing detail for a factory-correct restoration.
details: Protects door edges from chips and wear

name: 1967 Impala HT Door Edge Guards
description: Pair of door edge guards for the 1967 Impala Hardtop, all NOS (New Old Stock): original-style parts that were never installed. They protect door edges from chips and restore the correct factory look. Hard to find in unused condition.

name: 1967 Impala Wagon Door Edge Guards
description: Set of 2 door edge guards for the 1967 Impala Wagon in very good condition. Clean, complete and ready to install. A good option for a driver-quality wagon or a restoration where a correct look matters more than unused NOS parts.

name: 1962/67 Chevy II & Chevelle Door Guards
description: Set of 6 NOS door edge guards compatible with 1962-67 Chevy II and Chevelle. Because one set covers several model years, it is a practical find for restorers working on either car. Protects door edges and gives the correct factory finish.
details: Covers multiple years and two models
Please confirm your body style by email before ordering

name: 1961 Impala Wagon Door Gas Guards
description: Set of 6 door gas guards for the 1961 Impala Wagon, in good condition. Gas guards protect the door and paint area around the fuel filler from spills and wear. Good condition means normal age-related wear; ask us for close-up photos before you buy.
details: Protects the fuel filler area from spills and wear

name: 1962 Impala Wagon Door Gas Guard
description: Single door gas guard for the 1962 Impala Wagon, in very good condition. Only one piece is available, so it is a good match for filling a missing spot on an existing set.
details: Useful as a replacement for a missing guard

name: 1965/66 Impala Wagon Door Guards
description: Set of 3 NOS door edge guards for the 1965-66 Impala Wagon. Unused original-style parts that protect door edges and keep a restoration looking correct. Please check that 3 pieces covers the doors you need before ordering.
details: Check the quantity against the doors you need

name: Impala Backup Lamp Sets
description: Six sets of original-style Impala backup lamps in excellent condition, sold as a lot at the listed price. Backup lamps are a key lighting piece in any complete restoration. Ask us which Impala years we can confirm for these sets before you order.

details: Ideal for complete restorations or resale

name: 1961 Parking Lamps

name: 1965/66 Parking Brake Signal
description: NOS parking brake signal light for 1965-66. A rare interior piece that is difficult to find unused, and an important detail for a factory-correct interior.
